title_original: 설계·시공 최적화를 위한 연구보고서 (과제명: 개량형 PSC BEAM 적용방안) [부록] - 개량형 PSC BEAM 표준도
title_en: Research report on design and construction optimisation (task: application of the improved PSC beam), appendix: improved PSC beam standard drawings
organisation: 국토해양부 대전지방국토관리청 (Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs, Daejeon Regional Construction and Management Administration)

source.scan: A4 pages; each sheet is a 300 ppi 1-bit CCITT scan

geometry_notes: Only the midspan (중앙부) section is used. The end (단부, 1200-wide solid) and transition sections at 11.850/11.650/10.300 are excluded.
All three depths share the printed widths 1200 / 200 / 1000 (500+200+500 and 400+200+400), the top chain 150 + 60 and the bottom splay 150. Only the clear web changes: 865, 1165 and 1465.
The standard (표준형) and extended (확장형) series use identical midspan sections at the same H. Six span sheets therefore reduce to three distinct profiles.

CORRECTION: the H=1.4 and H=1.7 sheets, and the extended H=2.0 sheets, print the bottom-flange side as '75'. Their chains then sum 100 mm short of H (1300 vs 1400; 1600 vs 1700). The standard H=2.0 sheet (PDF p19) prints '175', which closes exactly (150+60+1465+150+175 = 2000). Scaled from the 300 ppi scans, the lowest segment measures about 160-175 mm on the H=1.4 and H=1.7 sheets, not 75. The value 175 is adopted for all three depths (a leading '1' lost at the dimension tick).

Fillets are implemented as tangent circular arcs, tessellated into 16 chords. Printed radii: R=50 at the convex top-flange underside corner, R=150 at the four re-entrant web junctions, R=100 at the convex bottom-flange shoulders.
CONVENTION: the top outer corners and soffit corners appear slightly rounded on the scans but carry no radius or chamfer callout. They are kept sharp.
The top splay runs from the flange side (x=600) to the web face (x=100) over 60 mm. The bottom splay runs from x=500 to x=100 over 150 mm.
No section-property table is printed. Checks are analytic only.
These are MLTM regional 개량형 (improved) beams. They are distinct from the existing KHC (Korea Expressway Corporation) standard I-girders in kr.kgm_i_section.
